---
title: "Mallard Duck Movement"
author: "Dana Prem"
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
mallards <- readRDS("data/mallards.rds")
```

```{r}
mallards_sf <- mallards |>
  filter(
    between(lat, 46, 55),
    between(long, 7, 25)
  ) |>
  st_as_sf(coords = c("long", "lat"), crs = 4326)

world <- rnaturalearth::ne_countries(
  scale = "medium",
  returnclass = "sf"
)

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = world, fill = "grey90", color = "grey60") +
  geom_sf(data = mallards_sf, aes(color = duck_id), alpha = 0.6, size = 0.5) +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(7, 25), ylim = c(46, 55), expand = FALSE) +
  theme_minimal()
```
